RQ: Which attack templates, goals, observed carriers, payload lengths and execution prerequisites accompany first-wave outcomes?
scope: 480 attacked seed17 episodes only, two prompt arms, fixed eight goals and two templates; seed29 excluded

definitions.U_A: Unmodified official U and exact attack A; errors remain unknown. No L or general unauthorized-action H scoring.
definitions.rate: Observed true / assigned episodes, with unknown count retained; does not assign unknown=False.
definitions.carrier: Observed function of the tool response containing submitted payload, from frozen actual_sources. Episode can have several carriers; deduplicated membership, not message count.
definitions.field_family: Candidate YAML source-field families from frozen attribution; payload matches can be ambiguous and one episode can have several families. This is not unique original-field attribution.
definitions.length: Exact assigned attack instruction string from trace.attack_payloads, including template and goal, Python Unicode character and whitespace-word counts. Excludes benign carrier text, serialization escaping, repeated history copies and tokenizer cost.
definitions.length_bins: Post-experiment descriptive chars ≤100/101–200/>200 and words ≤15/16–30/>30; only16 unique payload strings, so length is structurally tied to goal and template.
definitions.reference_overlap: At least one attack primary tool appears in the task reference tool sequence. It does not imply user authorization, sufficient parameters, actual agent use or minimum task complexity.
definitions.schema: Primary attack tools are available in every recorded request for all480. This does not establish that model knows how/when to use them, has parameter values, or has permission.
definitions.readiness: Frozen stage parameter_readiness_status at first submitted exposure; not a randomized factor. Literal goal constants, additional retrieval needs and raw state visibility are separate.
definitions.signature: Post-response-backed-exposure exact/related parameter-anchored call signature from frozen rules; describes observed action evidence, not hidden intent or causal attribution.
definitions.causality: Descriptive groups are confounded with suite, task, goal, style and exposure choices. No length, source or tool-overlap causal effect, ranking or significance claim.
